records.summary: Inspected the exact main-branch Cross Analysis and Scheduler Tick run logs, the approval workflow definition and failure record, and exact-head CI/gate results for three current-main safety PRs. Confirmed the 01:51 UTC scheduled Cross Analysis run directly pushed commit 7a780de to main; its only changed file was a sentiment_shift.json timestamp refresh with zero XRP/BTC samples and null scores. Confirmed the 02:20 Scheduler Tick was a no-op (0 entries fired; push reported up-to-date) despite retaining a credentialed commit/push path. Confirmed the approval workflow push-event anomaly has zero jobs and unknown cause. The three safety PRs are green on exact heads and based on current main but remain draft/unmerged.
actions: Read the Cross Analysis run's exact job logs and verified its successful git push to main.
Compared main's sentiment_shift.json with the parent version; only generated_at changed, while XRP/BTC sample counts remained zero and scores null.
Read the Scheduler Tick job log; it fired zero entries and performed no commit because the queue file was unchanged.
Read the approval workflow YAML and the push-event run; confirmed workflow_dispatch-only declaration, push event, zero jobs and unresolved cause.
Rechecked PR #1386, #1390 and #1388 against current main 7a780; all are open, draft, mergeable, exact-head CI green and fail-closed gate green.
Did not merge, approve, dispatch, alter main or change any paper-trading state.
blockers: Main's scheduled Cross Analysis write path remains active until PR #1386 is authorized and merged.
Scheduler Tick retains a commit/push and workflow-dispatch capability until PR #1390 is authorized and merged.

next_actions: Obtain explicit approval before merging any of PRs #1386, #1390 or #1388; do not merge automatically.
Keep the current main Cross Analysis workflow and scheduler isolated from further unreviewed writes; do not manually dispatch.

Request the narrow branch-protection/ruleset read permission only if required to inspect bypass actors and required reviews.
